title: Beyond LLM-Based Reasoning: Lightweight GNNs for Agent Failure Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2608.18575v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) often exhibit complex failure modes, which frequently cause agents to produce incorrect outcomes. This motivates the task of Agent Failure Attribution: given a failed multi-agent trajectory, identify the faulty agents and their corresponding error types. Existing approaches predominantly rely on LLMs to perform failure attribution, either through direct prompting, fine-tuning on synthetic data or complex agentic pipelines. While effective, these methods incur substantial computational overhead due to long-context processing, expensive post-training and handcrafted workflows. Moreover, empirical evidence shows that even state-of-the-art models achieve limited accuracy on existing benchmarks, suggesting that scaling model size alone is insufficient. translated_title: 超越基于LLM的推理：用于代理故障归因的轻量级图神经网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18575v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多代理系统（MAS）通常表现出复杂的故障模式，这常常导致代理产生错误结果。这推动了代理故障归因任务：给定一个失败的多代理轨迹，识别出有故障的代理及其对应的错误类型。现有方法主要依赖LLM进行故障归因，要么通过直接提示、基于合成数据的微调，要么通过复杂的代理流水线。尽管这些方法有效，但由于长上下文处理、昂贵的后训练和手工设计的工作流，它们产生了大量计算开销。此外，实证证据表明，即使最先进的模型在现有基准上也仅达到有限准确性，这表明仅扩大模型规模是不够的。在这项工作中，我们重新审视此任务，并质疑这种昂贵生成式解决方案的必要性。我们引入了AFANet，一种轻量级...
tldr: 本文质疑基于LLM的昂贵故障归因方法，提出轻量级图神经网络AFANet，以高效且准确地进行代理故障归因。
en_tdlr: This work questions the necessity of expensive LLM-based failure attribution and proposes AFANet, a lightweight GNN for efficient and accurate agent failure attribution.
